node.title: Re: HTML::TreeBuilder::LibXML creates multiple copies of the same result
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
my $xpath = '//div[@class="ccc"]/node()';

The way I understand that expression is "match any node of any kind that is a direct child of any

elements with a class attribute equal to ccc." If I remove all the whitespace from the XML, the matching
has three children: ,

Hello

, and
. And since node() matches any kind of nodes, including text nodes, that's what it's matching when you put the whitespace back in. You can see all of this in action if you put print "[[",$superCat->as_XML,"]]\n"; as the first thing in your loop. In other words, your XPath is behaving correctly. If you only want to match the
, change the expression to //div[@class="ccc"].

(Also note that your XML is not valid, the tag isn't closed.)
